description:
Auto-er Pilot
Autopilot steering for Starsector 0.98.5a.

Source code
Required mods: None. LunaLib is optional, for the settings menu.
Updating: Extract the new zip over the Auto-er Pilot folder in mods/. Saves and settings carry over.
Safe to add mid-game

Safe to remove mid-game

No required mods

Short summary
Basically, when your fleet is flying itself somewhere (a laid-in course, or you clicked a planet, star, jump point or gate), this makes it steer more like the NPC fleets do. It'll slow down in hyperspace storms and asteroid fields, ride slipstreams that are going your way, and go around coronas, black holes and fleets that are stronger than you. It also skips the jump point dialog when there's nothing waiting on the other side, and once you can use the gates it'll route you through them when that's shorter.

What it does
Storms
Slows down inside and just ahead of storm cells, since the game doesn't strike slow-moving fleets, then burns back up after. If going around the storm only adds a little (15% of the leg by default) it'll go around it. Slipstreams
Hops on a slipstream when it's going your way and saves at least 10% of the trip, and gets off at the best point. After leaving it, it fixes the sideways drift first so you don't get flung off course.
Reverse Polarity
If you have it, it'll turn it on before a wrong-way slipstream when riding it reversed is faster, and turn it off after. Outside a stream that's free. Without it, wrong-way streams are kept out of, or crossed straight across at the weakest spot. Sustained Burn
Turned on for longer trips and while riding a stream with the flow, but not with a stronger hostile fleet close by. If you turn it off yourself, it stays off until your next target.
Hazards and fleets
Goes around star coronas, black holes and hostile fleets that are stronger than you and can see you. If a star or black hole is the target, the fleet stops outside the corona. Asteroids
Slows down in asteroid belts and fields so you don't take impacts. There's no detour, since most of the time you can't really avoid them anyway.
Jump points
Jumps in and out of systems without the dialog. The dialog still shows up when the game would warn you about hostiles at the exit, ask about your transponder, or you're short on fuel, and for wormholes and unstable jump points. Fuel is the same as a normal jump. Gates
Once you've got the Janus Device working and At the Gates done, a laid-in course goes through two gates when that's at least 10% and one light year shorter. It flies to the gate, goes through without the dialog at the normal fuel cost, and lays your course back in on the other side. Laying in the same course again flies direct.
Taking control back
Holding the mouse button, the go-slow key, dialogs, battles and jumps give you control back. Clicking a station or a fleet is left to the game, so fights stay manual. The speed-up key doesn't stop it. Settings
Everything has its own switch in LunaLib (F3), or in data/config/better_autopilot.json if you don't use LunaLib. Nothing shows up on screen, it all goes to starsector.log.

Getting started
Extract it into mods/ and enable it in the launcher.
Lay in a course, or click a planet, star, jump point or gate.
If you want to turn anything off, it's in LunaLib (F3).

If anything weird happens, let me know here or on GitHub with your starsector.log.

Compatibility and permissions
Compatibility
Autopilot With Gates: Works alongside it. While its ability is on, gate routes are left to it.
AoTD Vaults of Knowledge: With a Bifrost Control Center on a colony, gate routes use Bifrost gates too, with the same cooldown as doing it by hand.
Random Assortment of Things: If your settlement has a Gate Beacon, gate routes can drop you off right there. It's only ever used as the exit, same as the gate dialog, since there's no gate to go in through.
Known conflicts: None known.
Known issues: Report them here or as GitHub issues, with starsector-core/starsector.log and your modlist. Permissions
Code: Free to use, change and reupload, in modpacks too. No credit needed. Do not sell it.
Assets: None. The mod has no art.

AI use disclaimer
Some or all assets and code in this mod were created using AI tools:
Code, docs and offline build checks: Claude Opus 5.5 (through Claude Code).
Design and in-game testing: Mjolniar.
Training data: None added. Art: None.

Made by Mjolniar | More: Auto Colonies | Auto Outfitting | all my mods on GitHub
